llm.summary: The skill retrieves public Douyin data through a disclosed service and saves results locally as documented.

dimensions.detail: Requests send query parameters and the explicitly configured GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN to a fixed HTTPS host, www.guaikei.com. No credential-file, browser-session, or broad local-content access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package uses Node.js built-ins without third-party dependencies or installation hooks. Its declared [public repository](https://github.com/um-why/douyin-search-openclaw) documents the same provider integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require user-provided queries, limit collection, prohibit unauthorized parameter changes, and stop on authentication failures.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Successful search, profile, and comment results are automatically saved under the skill's logs/ directory, with documented storage and save notices. Polling is bounded; no services, scheduled tasks, or privilege elevation were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Search, profile, comment, and trend retrieval match the stated research purpose; the code provides no social-account mutation operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install if you are comfortable sending search terms and Douyin links to GUAIKEI. Protect the API token, check service charges, and delete saved query and result logs when no longer needed. Output timestamps use Beijing time.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The advisory scanner incompletely inspected referenced CLIs. Direct inspection of both complete files and their dependencies found ordinary retrieval and documented result logging, without evidence of analysis evasion.
[PE3] unexpected: Credential-file access is not substantiated: the cited changelog says .env was removed. Runtime authentication reads only the declared API-token environment variable.
[LP3] expected: The API token and Node.js requirement are explicitly declared. Missing permissions or allowed-tools fields alone do not establish excessive authority.
[P9] expected: The flagged spaces align a Markdown parameter table; inspection found no concealed instructions.
[SQP-2] expected: Local persistence is confirmed, but the under-disclosure allegation is contradicted by SKILL.md, the README's destination and filename descriptions, and the logger's saved-path notice.
[SQP-3] expected: Beijing-time formatting is explicit and consistent across the schema, implementation, and changelog; this is an interoperability consideration rather than a security concern.
